recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future changes to ConceptMapRelationship semantics or publication of relationship-code comments should be handled by a new work-group decision, not by reopening this DSTU1 equivalence-code issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6029 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ConceptMap and requested more precise old ConceptMapEquivalence definitions: equal should be symmetric, reflexive, and transitive; subsumes and specializes should be reflexive and transitive; equal should imply both subsumes and specializes; subsumes and specializes should be converse relationships; and disjoint should be symmetric but not transitive.
initial_application: Git commit 5f4ac00ba3a00f87dba07ba0dac2c30d4a2aa2a3, the migrated svn revision 5694 cited in Jira, applied the issue by updating the ConceptMap spreadsheet spelling and adding terminology binding comments for equivalent/equal, subsumes, specializes, and disjoint.
additional_context: FHIR-22632 later replaced ConceptMap.group.element.target.equivalence with ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship, introduced ConceptMapRelationship, and retired ConceptMapEquivalence. FHIR-25923 approved explicit source-to-target relationship code names, FHIR-29946 added relationship-refinement guidance, and FHIR-16367/FHIR-16372 closed old-equivalence cleanup requests as superseded by the relationship model. FHIR-22632, FHIR-25923, and FHIR-29946 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current build-scoped ConceptMap source uses ConceptMapRelationship for target.relationship and unmapped.relationship, and the old ConceptMapEquivalence code system is not an active current ConceptMap source artifact beyond legacy OID/model-library references.
